From 6aaf3fd08d08e1bb9dc72bc2bd189464972d27c4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Michal Wajdeczko <michal.wajdeczko@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2024 14:07:49 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/xe/vf: Use correct check for being a VF driver
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The IS_SRIOV macro returns true also when we are running as a PF
driver. Use correct IS_SRIOV_VF macro to skip force-wake management.

Fixes: 513ea833c201 ("drm/xe/vf: Ignore force-wake requests if VF")
Signed-off-by: Michal Wajdeczko <michal.wajdeczko@intel.com>
Cc: Piotr Piórkowski <piotr.piorkowski@intel.com>
Cc: Rodrigo Vivi <rodrigo.vivi@intel.com>
Cc: Nirmoy Das <nirmoy.das@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Piotr Piórkowski <piotr.piorkowski@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Nirmoy Das <nirmoy.das@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240613120749.2032-1-michal.wajdeczko@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_force_wake.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_force_wake.c
index 5db6926120c3..b263fff15273 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_force_wake.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_force_wake.c
@@ -97,7 +97,7 @@ void xe_force_wake_init_engines(struct xe_gt *gt, struct xe_force_wake *fw)
 
 static void __domain_ctl(struct xe_gt *gt, struct xe_force_wake_domain *domain, bool wake)
 {
-	if (IS_SRIOV(gt_to_xe(gt)))
+	if (IS_SRIOV_VF(gt_to_xe(gt)))
 		return;
 
 	xe_mmio_write32(gt, domain->reg_ctl, domain->mask | (wake ? domain->val : 0));
@@ -108,7 +108,7 @@ static int __domain_wait(struct xe_gt *gt, struct xe_force_wake_domain *domain,
 	u32 value;
 	int ret;
 
-	if (IS_SRIOV(gt_to_xe(gt)))
+	if (IS_SRIOV_VF(gt_to_xe(gt)))
 		return 0;
 
 	ret = xe_mmio_wait32(gt, domain->reg_ack, domain->val, wake ? domain->val : 0,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_force_wake.c`**
   - The macro `IS_SRIOV` was replaced with `IS_SRIOV_VF` in two instances within the `__domain_ctl` and `__domain_wait` functions.
   - This change ensures that the code correctly identifies when it is operating as a Virtual Function (VF) driver, thereby skipping force-wake management when appropriate.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in `xe_force_wake.c` are directly related to the bug fix indicated in the patch. The original use of the `IS_SRIOV` macro was incorrect as it also returned true for Physical Function (PF) drivers. By switching to the `IS_SRIOV_VF` macro, the code now accurately checks for VF drivers, preventing unnecessary force-wake management in those cases. This change addresses the issue introduced in a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag) and improves the functionality of the driver in a virtualized environment.

Here is the commit message:
drm/xe/vf: Use correct check for being a VF driver
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The IS_SRIOV macro returns true also when we are running as a PF
driver. Use correct IS_SRIOV_VF macro to skip force-wake management.

Fixes: 513ea833c201 ("drm/xe/vf: Ignore force-wake requests if VF")
Signed-off-by: Michal Wajdeczko <michal.wajdeczko@intel.com>
Cc: Piotr Piórkowski <piotr.piorkowski@intel.com>
Cc: Rodrigo Vivi <rodrigo.vivi@intel.com>
Cc: Nirmoy Das <nirmoy.das@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Piotr Piórkowski <piotr.piorkowski@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Nirmoy Das <nirmoy.das@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240613120749.2032-1-michal.wajdeczko@intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect use of the `IS_SRIOV` macro, which returned true for both Physical Function (PF) and Virtual Function (VF) drivers. This led to inappropriate force-wake management being applied to PF drivers when it should have been skipped for VF drivers. The correct macro, `IS_SRIOV_VF`, needed to be used to accurately identify VF drivers and prevent unnecessary operations.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void __domain_ctl(struct xe_gt *gt, struct xe_force_wake_domain *domain, bool wake)
 {
-	if (IS_SRIOV(gt_to_xe(gt)))
+	if (IS_SRIOV_VF(gt_to_xe(gt)))
 		return;
 
 	xe_mmio_write32(gt, domain->reg_ctl, domain->mask | (wake ? domain->val : 0));
 }
 
 static int __domain_wait(struct xe_gt *gt, struct xe_force_wake_domain *domain, bool wake)
 {
 	u32 value;
 	int ret;
 
-	if (IS_SRIOV(gt_to_xe(gt)))
+	if (IS_SRIOV_VF(gt_to_xe(gt)))
 		return 0;
 
 	ret = xe_mmio_wait32(gt, domain->reg_ack, domain->val, wake ? domain->val : 0,
 			     XE_FORCE_WAKE_ACK_TIMEOUT_MS * USEC_PER_MSEC,
 			     &value, true);
 	if (ret)
 		xe_gt_notice(gt, "Force wake domain %d failed to ack %s (%pe) reg[%#x] = %#x\n",
 			     domain->id, str_wake_sleep(wake), ERR_PTR(ret),
 			     domain->reg_ack.addr, value);
 
 	return ret;
 }
